items.title: Why This Page
items.why:
I built the Weezy look from your review 50 picks. Those mock-ups didn't load iRob's fonts: the app blocked them, so the pictures showed a plain serif font. These pictures are the real build.

In the real Cinzel, headings and buttons are in small capitals, as in iRob, because Cinzel has no lowercase letters. Nothing is published.

items.title: Headings and Buttons
items.why: Text in the lists and sentences is Lora either way. The bottom bar stays in Lora so Quick Add fits on one line.

options.label: Lora, bold
options.desc: Upper and lower case, like the review 50 pictures.

items.title: The Finale Card
items.why: Weezy rises when all seven gold hearts are gathered. The card takes the iRob colors instead of the Dragon Ball green.

items.title: Still Waiting for the Scale
items.why: You picked a ChatGPT scale icon first, so 2.34.0 goes out once that picture is in.
